lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Three primary columns are visible, each containing three to four nodes forming a localized grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance nodes, creating a visible matrix of anchor points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and defined shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of five commensal fish (remoras) is visible in the water column immediately below the pectoral fin.
